companyDescription: AI Photonics · POET Optical Interposer™ platform integrates electronics + photonics on a single chip — enabling 800G optical engines for hyperscale data center AI infrastructure; Malaysia high-volume production on track for Q3 2026, but funded by heavy dilution and clouded by a Celestial AI (Marvell subsidiary) order cancellation
priceNote: Down from the $9.99 level of the last report despite genuinely positive operational news (board added optics-industry veterans Aug 6, new COO from Silicon Labs, Malaysia 800G ramp confirmed on track). The overhang: shares outstanding have grown to 172.6M (+63.6% in one year) after $830M raised in equity over 12 months, including a $400M registered direct offering — and Celestial AI (a Marvell subsidiary) cancelled all outstanding orders following the CEO NDA-violation allegation, a real negative that wasn't yet confirmed at the last report.
summary: Two real, opposing updates since the last report. Positive: POET added optics-industry heavyweights to its board (Aug 6, 2026), hired a new COO (Sandeep Kumar, ex-Silicon Labs) to lead Malaysian production, signed a manufacturing agreement with Globetronics, and confirmed the 800G ramp remains on track for Q3 2026 with a long-term target of 1M units/month by end-2027. Negative, and new since the last report: Celestial AI (a Marvell subsidiary) cancelled all its outstanding orders with POET following the confirmed CEO NDA-violation allegation, and the company has now raised $830M in equity over 12 months (shares outstanding +63.6% YoY to 172.6M) — a much larger, now-realized dilution story than the 'overhang' framed last time. The PFIC lawsuit remains unresolved. Net effect: the stock is lower despite real production progress, because a real customer loss and heavy dilution are now confirmed, not just risks.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings + Malaysia 800G Ramp Confirmation
catalysts.description: Estimated for Aug 19, 2026 (not yet reconfirmed for this specific quarter) — will reveal first 800G optical engine shipment data from Malaysia against the 30,000+ engine 2026 target, and management's read on the Celestial AI order cancellation's revenue impact.

catalysts.name: Malaysia High-Volume Production Go-Live
catalysts.description: Confirmed on track at the Jun 26 annual meeting: 800G output begins Q3 2026 at the Malaysia facility (Globetronics manufacturing agreement in place), with a long-term target of 1M units/month by end-2027. Successful production validation is the fundamental de-risking event this thesis needs.

catalysts.name: Celestial AI (Marvell) Order Cancellation + PFIC Lawsuit
catalysts.description: New and realized since the last report: Celestial AI (a Marvell subsidiary) cancelled all outstanding orders with POET after a senior manager was alleged to have violated a confidentiality agreement in a public interview. The separate PFIC class-action lawsuit (Apr 1-27, 2026 period) also remains unresolved — both are now confirmed overhangs, not just risks.

risks: REALIZED: Celestial AI (Marvell subsidiary) cancelled all outstanding orders with POET following a confirmed CEO/senior-manager NDA-violation allegation — this was a risk flagged last report and has now materialized into an actual lost customer

REALIZED: Shares outstanding grew 63.6% over the past year to 172.6M after $830M raised in equity over 12 months (including a $400M registered direct offering at effectively dilutive terms) — up to $661M more could come via outstanding warrants, meaning the dilution story is ongoing, not a one-time event
PFIC class action lawsuits remain unresolved, continuing to suppress US institutional buying and create legal overhang
Canadian domicile means US investors face adverse PFIC tax treatment — a structural demand headwind independent of the lawsuit outcome
Single-name analyst coverage remains thin (Northland's $7 target is from Dec 2024 — badly outdated on both price and thesis)
Production ramp execution risk remains real: any delay to the Q3 2026 Malaysia 800G shipments would remove the one clean offsetting positive in this story

estimateDates.note: Not yet officially reconfirmed for this quarter; 800G ramp + Celestial AI impact are the key reads
Confirmed on track at the Jun 26 annual meeting; 30,000+ optical engines targeted for 2026

analystTargets.note: Dec 2024 — badly outdated; predates both the Malaysia ramp confirmation and the Celestial AI cancellation

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.50-3.75% on Jul 29, 2026, with 3 of 12 officials dissenting toward a hike — the most hawkish split since 2016. A cash-burning, heavily-dilutive small-cap like POET is directly exposed to any further tightening in financing conditions.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE still 3.3% YoY. A hot CPI print (Aug 12) could compress growth-stock multiples broadly, on top of POET's already-heavy company-specific dilution.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI photonics hardware benefits structurally from data-center capex even in a higher-rate environment, but POET's own realized dilution (+63.6% share count YoY) is now a bigger swing factor for the stock than sector-wide rate sensitivity.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM-HIGH within this dashboard — the AI photonics demand story is real and rate-insensitive, but POET's own financing behavior (three large raises totaling $830M in a year, more warrants outstanding) makes it unusually exposed to any tightening in risk appetite or financing conditions.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE — 5% max position. The Malaysia 800G ramp is genuinely on track and the board/COO additions are real quality upgrades, but a confirmed customer loss (Celestial AI) and heavy realized dilution (+63.6% share count YoY) are worse than the 'overhang' framing from the last report. Wait for the ~Aug 19 print before adding.

catalystSpot.preRunup: AI photonics names typically run 15-25% pre-production milestone announcements as spec buyers position ahead of ramp confirmations, but POET's own pattern this cycle has been dominated by dilution and legal news overwhelming any pre-ramp positioning.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 4–8 weeks before earnings/ramp confirmation, historically — muted this cycle by dilution/legal overhang
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: +15% to +25% historically; likely dampened given the realized negatives

postWin.note: Comparable optical component ramp confirmations (e.g., II-VI/Coherent 400G volume in Dec 2021) drove +30-50% moves over 4-6 weeks. POET's 800G at smaller scale suggests similar % magnitude if the Aug ~19 print shows clean shipment data.

postLose.note: When MACOM had production delays in 2019, the stock fell 35% over 2 months. A POET ramp miss stacked on the already-realized Celestial AI loss and dilution would likely trigger a similar or worse de-rating.

spotSizing.reason: The AI photonics thesis and Malaysia ramp progress remain real, but the newly-realized Celestial AI order cancellation and heavy dilution (+63.6% share count) lower the appropriate sizing versus the last report's 5% — genuine negatives have now materialized, not just risks.

th.summary: มีอัปเดตจริง 2 ด้านที่ตรงข้ามกันตั้งแต่รายงานก่อน ด้านบวก: POET เพิ่มผู้เชี่ยวชาญ optics เข้าบอร์ด (6 ส.ค. 2026) จ้าง COO ใหม่ (Sandeep Kumar อดีต Silicon Labs) คุมการผลิตมาเลเซีย เซ็นสัญญาผลิตกับ Globetronics และยืนยัน 800G ramp ยังตรงเป้า Q3 2026 เป้าระยะยาว 1 ล้านชิ้น/เดือนภายในสิ้นปี 2027 ด้านลบ ใหม่ตั้งแต่รายงานก่อน: Celestial AI (บริษัทลูก Marvell) ยกเลิกออเดอร์ที่คงค้างทั้งหมดกับ POET หลังยืนยันข้อกล่าวหาการละเมิด NDA ของ CEO และบริษัทระดมทุน $830M ในรอบ 12 เดือน (จำนวนหุ้น +63.6% YoY เป็น 172.6M) — เป็นเรื่อง dilution ที่เกิดขึ้นจริงและใหญ่กว่าที่เคยกรอบเป็นแค่ 'overhang' คดี PFIC ยังไม่คลี่คลาย ผลสุทธิ: หุ้นราคาต่ำลงแม้จะมีความคืบหน้าการผลิตจริง เพราะการเสียลูกค้าจริงและ dilution หนักเป็นสิ่งที่เกิดขึ้นแล้ว ไม่ใช่แค่ความเสี่ยง
th.priceNote: ลงจากระดับ $9.99 ของรายงานก่อน แม้จะมีข่าวปฏิบัติการเชิงบวกจริง (บอร์ดเพิ่มผู้เชี่ยวชาญ optics 6 ส.ค., COO ใหม่จาก Silicon Labs, ramp มาเลเซียยืนยันตรงเป้า) ตัวถ่วง: จำนวนหุ้นเพิ่มเป็น 172.6M (+63.6% ในหนึ่งปี) หลังระดมทุน $830M ในปีที่ผ่านมา รวมการเสนอขายตรง $400M — และ Celestial AI (บริษัทลูก Marvell) ยกเลิกออเดอร์ทั้งหมดหลังข้อกล่าวหา NDA ของ CEO ได้รับการยืนยัน ซึ่งยังไม่ยืนยันตอนรายงานก่อน
